result.summary: The page looks generally well-designed and functional. A few minor visual concerns were found: horizontally cut-off category chips and restaurant cards, a truncated restaurant name, and one low-contrast 'See all' link.

issues.description: The category filter row (All, Pizza, Sushi, Burgers, Healthy) is cut off on the right edge with a partially visible chip, which is expected scroll behavior but appears slightly clipped without an affordance
issues.suggestion: Add a subtle edge fade or partial next-chip preview so users clearly understand the row scrolls horizontally

issues.description: The third 'Fastest near you' card (Trattoria Piccol...) is cut off at the screen edge and its name is truncated with an ellipsis
issues.suggestion: This is acceptable for a horizontally scrolling carousel, but ensure the truncation gracefully reveals the full name on tap, or add a fade gradient at the edge

issues.description: The 'See all' links use green text that may have insufficient contrast against the white background at small text sizes
issues.suggestion: Verify the green color meets WCAG AA (4.5:1) contrast ratio for small text, or darken the green slightly

issues.description: The bottom pizza card with the -20% badge is cut off at the bottom of the viewport with no indication of more content
issues.suggestion: This is normal scroll behavior, but consider showing a sliver of the restaurant name below the image so users know it's a tappable card
